'''Bożena Hilczer''' (1936 – 26 March 2025) was a Polish physicist at the [[Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences]] (IFM PAN) in Poznań.<ref name="IFM-PT">{{cite web |title=Special issue of Phase Transitions |url=https://www.ifmpan.poznan.pl/en/news-archive/377-special-issue-of-phase-transitions.html |website=Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences |access-date=22 December 2025}}</ref> She worked in ferroelectrics, charge storage in dielectrics, dielectric dynamics in ferroic structures, superprotonic phase transitions and proton transport, and functional ceramic–polymer composites.<ref name="IFM-PT" />

== Early life and education ==
Hilczer was born in 1936 in Bydgoszcz, Poland.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She completed an MSc degree in physics at [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań]] in 1958.<ref name="IFM-PT" />

== Career ==
In 1958, Hilczer began research work as an assistant in the Poznań branch of the Institute of Physics of the Polish Academy of Sciences (PAS).<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She received a PhD in 1965 and became head of the Ferroelectrics Department.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She obtained habilitation in solid-state physics in 1974 at the Institute of Physics PAS in Warsaw.<ref name="IFM-PT" />

In 1975 she joined the newly autonomous Institute of Molecular Physics PAS in Poznań as an assistant professor and was awarded the title of full professor in 1981.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She formally retired in 2011 and continued as professor emerita from 2012.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She died on 26 March 2025, aged 88.<ref name="IFM-Obit">{{cite web |title=Zmarła prof. dr hab. Bożena Hilczer |url=https://www.ifmpan.poznan.pl/pl/informacje/1017-zmarla-prof-dr-hab-bozena-hilczer.html |website=Instytut Fizyki Molekularnej Polskiej Akademii Nauk |date=26 March 2025 |access-date=22 December 2025 |language=pl}}</ref>

== Research and teaching ==
Between 1985 and 2000, Hilczer delivered courses on topics including lattice defects in ferroelectrics, physics of dielectrics, smart materials, and sensors and actuators.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She investigated how defects, irradiation and doping affect ferroelectric properties and phase transitions, including radiation-induced transitions and behaviour near Curie temperatures.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> Her work also addressed charge storage phenomena in dielectrics, including electrets, piezopolymers and ferroelectric polymers, as well as dielectric response and dynamics in ferroelectric and ferroelastic structures.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> She co-authored specialist monographs on electrets and related materials in Polish.<ref name="KaRo-NUKAT">{{cite web |title=Hilczer, Bożena (1936– ) – catalogue records |url=https://karo.umk.pl/K_3.02/Exec/z2w_f.pl?al=u&bib=NUKAT&detail=5&di=aHilczer%2C+Bo%C5%BCena&dist=2&kl=14927-1600628574&lang=pl&liczba=30&lok=all&pm=b&pp=1&priority=1&pubyearh=&pubyearl=&qt=F&st1=aeHilczer+Bo%C5%BCena&uid=megg |access-date=22 December 2025 |website=KaRo – Rozproszony Katalog Bibliotek Polskich (NUKAT) |language=pl}}</ref> She held a patent related to electret microphone diaphragms and co-authored a technology for pyroelectric detectors based on piezopolymers.<ref name="IFM-PT" /> 

J. F. Scott discussed irradiation experiments by Hilczer as demonstrating that defect populations can generate strong anomalies in measurements near ferroelectric phase transitions, and that such effects can be removed by annealing and reproduced by renewed irradiation.<ref name="Scott2016">{{cite journal |last=Scott |first=J. F. |title=Absence of critical exponents in ferroelectrics: experiments of Hilczer and theory of Levanyuk and Sigov |journal=Phase Transitions |volume=89 |issue=7–8 |pages=645–650 |year=2016 |doi=10.1080/01411594.2015.1127923 |url=https://research-repository.st-andrews.ac.uk/handle/10023/10019?show=full |access-date=22 December 2025|hdl=10023/10019 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>

== Professional activities ==
Hilczer was involved in the Polish–Czech Seminar on Structural and Ferroelectric Phase Transitions, originated in discussions between her and Jan Fousek, and these bilateral meetings have been held alternately in the two countries since 1979.<ref name="IFM-PolCze-Issue">{{cite web |title=XXII Polish-Czech Seminar – Special Issue |url=https://www.ifmpan.poznan.pl/pol-cze-16/issue.html |access-date=22 December 2025 |website=Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences}}</ref><ref name="IEEE-InMemoria">{{cite web |title=In Memoria (Jan Fousek biography page) |url=https://ieee-uffc.org/contact/jan-fousek#memoriam |access-date=22 December 2025 |website=IEEE Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control Society}}</ref>

She was chair of the Polish Society for Crystal Growth (PTWK) awards chapter (''kapituła nagród''), among those involved in the society’s awards activity for the 2001–2004 term.<ref name="PTWK-Hist">{{cite web |title=Historia Polskiego Towarzystwa Wzrostu Kryształów (PTWK) |url=https://skaczmarek.zut.edu.pl/ptwk_2016.pdf |access-date=22 December 2025 |language=pl |format=PDF}}</ref><ref name="PTWK-2001-2004">{{cite web |title=Sprawozdanie Zarządu PTWK z działalności w okresie 2001–2004 (Materiały Elektroniczne) |url=https://rcin.org.pl/Content/17971 |format=PDF |access-date=22 December 2025 |language=pl}}</ref>
